summary.prose: insrc_present currently refuses to open a document unless the daemon's pending-approval list includes it, and that list is also gated by a code-review-readiness rule that can never be satisfied while review is disabled -- so a perfectly normal, not-yet-decided artifact (like a tracked-epic Story's BUILD record) can never be shown. This Story adds a small, separate lookup the chat's present/approve flow uses instead: it answers only 'does this name resolve to exactly one real artifact record', regardless of that artifact's lifecycle status, leaving the existing pending-approval list (and the IDE plugins' review panel that also depends on it) completely unchanged.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

api.name: resolveOpenableArtifacts
api.signature: resolveOpenableArtifacts(repoPath: string): readonly { readonly artifactId: string; readonly mdPath: string }[]

parameters.name: repoPath
parameters.purpose: Absolute repo path whose .insrc/artifacts directory is scanned.

returns.type: readonly { readonly artifactId: string; readonly mdPath: string }[]
returns.meaning: One entry per PENDING_KINDS artifact file on disk, regardless of lifecycle status or the BUILD/CR-sibling precondition -- artifactId (filename minus .json) and mdPath (via the existing, status-independent deriveMdPath).

postconditions: Every PENDING_KINDS artifact file under .insrc/artifacts is represented exactly once, independent of its approvalStateOf result and independent of whether a sibling CR-*.json exists
A malformed artifact file is skipped (logged), matching listPendingArtifacts' existing one-bad-file-must-not-drop-the-rest behavior

api.name: deriveMdPath
api.signature: deriveMdPath(repoPath: string, kind: ArtifactKind, meta: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): string

parameters.name: meta
parameters.purpose: The artifact's own meta block, used to derive its slug/anchor.

postconditions: Unchanged existing behavior -- resolveOpenableArtifacts reuses it as-is, no modification

api.name: handleInsrcPresent
api.signature: handleInsrcPresent(args: InsrcPresentArgs, deps: InsrcPresentDeps = {}): Promise<{ content: { type: 'text'; text: string }[]; isError?: boolean }>

parameters.name: args
parameters.purpose: The declared document names (artifact ids or paths).

parameters.name: deps
parameters.purpose: Test seams for the pending-list call and repo resolver.

returns.meaning: Unchanged external response shape: { presented: string[], notPending: string[] } as the text payload.

postconditions: The openable set it filters names against now comes from resolveOpenableArtifacts instead of pending.artifacts (listPendingArtifacts via pendingWorkflow); namesPending's matching logic is reused unchanged since it only needs {artifactId, mdPath}
External request/response shape of the insrc_present MCP tool is unchanged -- only the internal data source for openability changes

errorCases.scenario: A declared name does not resolve to any artifact file at all (misspelled id or path).
errorCases.detection: resolveOpenableArtifacts' scan over .insrc/artifacts finds no PENDING_KINDS file whose artifactId or mdPath matches the declared name.
errorCases.response: handleInsrcPresent places the name in notPending, exactly as today for an unmatched name -- no behavior change for this case.
errorCases.userImpact: The caller sees notPending and must correct the name before presenting again.

errorCases.scenario: A bare filename (e.g. a plain 'PLAN.md') matches more than one artifact across different Stories.
errorCases.detection: namesPending's filter over resolveOpenableArtifacts' output returns more than one match for the same declared name.
errorCases.response: The ambiguous name is reported as notPending, not guessed at -- the existing ambiguity rule in handleInsrcPresent is unchanged, now evaluated over the broader (status-independent) candidate set.
errorCases.userImpact: Caller must disambiguate with a more specific path or the artifact id.

errorCases.scenario: A malformed artifact JSON file exists under .insrc/artifacts (corrupted or partially written).
errorCases.detection: JSON.parse throws while resolveOpenableArtifacts scans that file.
errorCases.response: The malformed file is skipped and logged, matching listPendingArtifacts' existing one-bad-file-must-not-drop-the-rest behavior; the scan continues over the remaining files.
errorCases.userImpact: That one malformed artifact cannot be presented, but every other declared name still resolves correctly.

edgeCases.input: An artifact kind outside PENDING_KINDS (e.g. a STUB or an EPIC/STORY/TASK record).
edgeCases.expected: Not included in resolveOpenableArtifacts' output -- insrc_present never presents a non-reviewable kind, matching today's scope exactly.

edgeCases.input: An artifact whose lifecycle status is already 'approved' or 'rejected'.
edgeCases.expected: Now included in resolveOpenableArtifacts' output (unlike listPendingArtifacts); insrc_present reports it as presented if its name resolves uniquely. Re-approving it is still governed separately by insrc_workflow_approve's own lifecycle checks, so presenting a decided artifact carries no approval risk.

edgeCases.input: A tracked-epic BUILD record with no CR-*.json sibling (the reported defect's exact case).
edgeCases.expected: Now included in resolveOpenableArtifacts' output -- the CR-sibling precondition is not reapplied; insrc_present reports it as presented.

invariantsToPreserve.text: A malformed artifact file must not drop the rest of the scan: one bad file is skipped and logged, not a thrown error that fails the whole lookup.
A declared name matching more than one document stays ambiguous and is reported notPending rather than guessed at.

migration.stateBefore: handleInsrcPresent (src/mcp/server.ts:1105-1140) derives its entire openable set from pending.artifacts, sourced from listPendingArtifacts (src/workflow/pending.ts:116-157), which excludes any non-standalone BUILD lacking a CR-*.json sibling (pending.ts:152) and any artifact whose lifecycle state is not 'pending' (pending.ts:143).
migration.stateAfter: handleInsrcPresent derives its openable set from a new function, resolveOpenableArtifacts, that enumerates every PENDING_KINDS artifact file regardless of lifecycle status or CR-sibling existence; listPendingArtifacts, handleWorkflowPending and the workflow.pending IPC method are unchanged, so the IDE plugins' review panel's behavior is identical before and after.

migrationSteps.action: Add the new resolveOpenableArtifacts function to src/workflow/pending.ts, reusing the existing file-scan shape and the already-exported deriveMdPath for path derivation, with no lifecycle-state or CR-sibling filter.

Change handleInsrcPresent in src/mcp/server.ts to read its openable set from resolveOpenableArtifacts instead of pending.artifacts (pendingWorkflow/listPendingArtifacts), keeping namesPending and the ambiguity rule unchanged.
Update/extend tests covering handleInsrcPresent and the new resolveOpenableArtifacts per the test strategy.

migration.backwardCompat: insrc_present's external MCP request/response shape ({ documents } in, { presented, notPending } out) is unchanged. No caller of listPendingArtifacts/workflow.pending/the IDE panel is touched, so that consumer's behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged. The only observable behavior change is that insrc_present now also presents artifacts it previously refused (already-approved/rejected artifacts, and a tracked-epic BUILD with no CR sibling) -- a strict widening, not a narrowing, so no existing caller that depended on a name being presented can regress.

alternativesConsidered.name: New minimal status-independent resolver, exported from pending.ts
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Add a new, separate exported function in pending.ts that scans the same PENDING_KINDS artifact files but skips the lifecycle-state and CR-sibling filters, returning only {artifactId, mdPath} pairs; handleInsrcPresent uses it instead of listPendingArtifacts/pending.artifacts.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Reuse the existing file-scan loop shape and deriveMdPath (already exported, status-independent) to build a minimal descriptor {artifactId, mdPath} for every PENDING_KINDS artifact file on disk, with NO lifecycle-state check and NO BUILD/CR-sibling check. Export it from pending.ts as its own function, name TBD at contract.detail. handleInsrcPresent (server.ts:1105-1140) calls this new function as its sole source for the openable set, dropping its dependency on pending.artifacts entirely; namesPending's matching logic (server.ts:1098-1101) is unchanged since it only needs artifactId+mdPath. listPendingArtifacts itself, the workflow.pending IPC method, and the IDE plugins' review panel are completely untouched -- their 'awaiting a decision' semantics stay intact. The minimal {artifactId, mdPath} shape matches exactly what insrc_present's own response needs (it returns only presented[]/notPending[] string buckets, never title/kind/state), so no richer descriptor is needed.
pros: Insrc_present's openability becomes fully independent of listPendingArtifacts' business rules, resolving the root cause directly
listPendingArtifacts and its one known production caller (handleWorkflowPending/workflow.pending, which the IDE panel also depends on) are untouched -- zero regression risk to that consumer
Reuses deriveMdPath (already exported, already status-independent) instead of duplicating path-derivation logic
Minimal new surface: one new function, one new call site change in handleInsrcPresent
cons: Introduces a second artifact-enumeration function in pending.ts alongside listPendingArtifacts, which a future reader must understand are deliberately different (mitigated by a doc comment explaining the split)
Does not share toDescriptor's richer PendingArtifact shape, so if a future caller of insrc_present's response ever wants title/kind, this function would need extending

alternativesConsidered.name: Widen listPendingArtifacts with an opt-out flag
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Add an optional parameter to listPendingArtifacts itself (e.g. an 'includeAllStatuses' flag) that skips the state/CR-sibling checks when set, and have handleInsrcPresent pass it while the IDE panel's call path keeps the default.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Change listPendingArtifacts's signature to accept an options object with an opt-in flag; when set, the loop body skips both the approvalStateOf check and the BUILD/CR-sibling check, returning every PENDING_KINDS artifact regardless of status. handleWorkflowPending (and therefore workflow.pending/the IDE panel) keeps calling it with the flag unset (default pending-only behavior unchanged); handleInsrcPresent's caller of pendingWorkflow would need its own new code path that calls listPendingArtifacts directly with the flag set, bypassing pendingWorkflow/workflow.pending IPC (since that IPC method has no reason to ever return all-statuses to the IDE panel).
pros: Reuses listPendingArtifacts's existing loop body verbatim via a single conditional, no new function to maintain
toDescriptor's PendingArtifact shape (with richer fields) is reused as-is
cons: Conflates two genuinely different callers' needs into one function via an implicit boolean flag -- exactly the coupling the filed ISSUE identifies as the root cause, just moved one layer down instead of removed

A future caller could pass the wrong flag value by mistake, silently regressing either consumer; the two concerns (IDE pending-list vs insrc_present openability) no longer have separate call surfaces to catch that at compile time

toDescriptor's return type hardcodes state: 'pending' as a literal -- reusing it for a non-pending artifact produces a descriptor whose own state field lies about the artifact's real status, which would need a separate fix anyway
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: A boolean flag threaded through the same shared function listPendingArtifacts is a narrower, riskier form of decoupling than a separate function: a future caller could pass the wrong flag value and silently regress either consumer, and reusing toDescriptor's PendingArtifact shape would carry a state: 'pending' literal that lies about a non-pending artifact's real status.

alternativesConsidered.name: Inline ad hoc resolution in server.ts, no shared helper
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Duplicate a minimal file-scan + path-derivation directly inside server.ts's handleInsrcPresent, without touching pending.ts at all.
alternativesConsidered.approach: handleInsrcPresent reads .insrc/artifacts directly, re-implementing enough of the kind-prefix parsing and path derivation to answer 'does this name match exactly one artifact file' without importing anything new from pending.ts.
pros: Zero risk of touching pending.ts's own exports or its existing test suite
cons: Duplicates scan/path-derivation logic pending.ts's own module doc already centralizes as 'the single source of truth' for this exact concern (pending.ts:6-20), directly contradicting that stated design intent

Two independent implementations of 'how do I find an artifact's file' will drift as the artifact-id/path scheme evolves (e.g. if resolveArtifactMdPath's logic changes, this duplicate would silently go stale)
Does not reuse deriveMdPath even though it already does exactly what's needed
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Duplicates scan/path-derivation logic pending.ts's own module doc already calls the single source of truth for this concern, at higher cost (M) than a1 (S) for an inferior outcome, with a real drift risk as the artifact-id/path scheme evolves.
